XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine fault light comes on with vehicle functioning correctly
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | SOLENOID VALVE | VARIATOR | PHASE | VALVE | ELECTRIC | ELECTRONIC | P0009 | P0011 | LIGHTS UP | ON | MIL | YELLOW | WORKS | NORMALLY | NORMAL | TIMING | VARIABLE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Variable valve timing solenoid valve

  • Fault: The engine fault warning light is illuminated whilst the vehicle continues to run normally

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • P0011 (Camshaft 1 position/phase, bank 1 – Advance angle)
    • P0009 (Engine timing/control system, bank 2 – Fault)
  • Cause: Faulty variable valve timing solenoid valve

• Action: Check that the solenoid valve is working properly and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: Part of the phase variator solenoid valve is immersed in oil; it is accessible from the top of the engine compartment, above the tappet cover, on the passenger side. In this case, the tappet cover was initially cleaned without resolving the fault. The definitive solution was found by simply replacing the valve.
    The defective component did not show any visual faults.
